desc:
TASTY ORIGINAL: Munch on the Bugles Crispy Corn Snacks you know and love, in its classic original flavor

PANTRY AND PARTY FAVORITE: A pantry staple that's delicious alone or added to your favorite party snack mix recipes; A fun alternative to ordinary chips that's a blast to play with

PACK SOME TO GO: Perfect snack addition for the lunch box or the office snack drawer; Take some to munch on later as you head out the door

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Tasty for both kids and kids at heart, enjoy all kinds of creative ways to eat this delicious snack

CONTAINS: One 7.5 oz bag of Bugles Original Crispy Corn Snacks
features:
Features

Iconic Cone Shape

Bugles are known for their unique, cone-like shape that adds fun to snacking and makes them stand out from other chips.

Crispy, Crunchy Texture

Made from cornmeal and fried to a golden crisp, they deliver a light, airy crunch in every bite.

Simple Ingredients

Typically made with cornmeal, coconut or palm oil, sugar, and salt. No artificial flavors or colors in the original version.

Zero Trans Fat

Contains no trans fat and zero cholesterol per serving, making it a slightly better-for-you snack compared to some alternatives.

Available in Multiple Sizes

Sold in small, individual bags or large family-size packs—great for both solo snacking and group sharing.

Benefits

Fun & Nostalgic Snack

A long-time favorite since the 1960s, Bugles are often associated with childhood memories and playful eating experiences.

Great for Parties & Mixes

Their shape and taste make them a perfect addition to snack mixes or as a crunchy topper for creative snack recipes.

Convenient & Portable

Easy to pack for road trips, lunchboxes, or work breaks due to their light weight and resealable packaging options.

Satisfies Savory Cravings

Their lightly salted, corn-based flavor offers a satisfying option when you're craving something salty and crunchy.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Vegetable Oil (coconut and/or palm), Sugar, Salt, Distilled Monoglycerides, Baking Soda. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
